scenario: [RLOW.6.1.9]: on integer storage `math.sign(x)` of a tier-1 unit is the builtin over `Q·x - R`, negated when `P` is negative. `owed` is `x * -100` cents. Slot `o` holds -250 cents, 2.5 owed, so `math.sign(r.o)` is 1; slot `p` holds 350 cents, -3.5 owed, so `math.sign(r.p)` is -1. Both rules log. The base number's signs are -1 and 1, so a sign taken in the base unit logs neither. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.rlow_6_1_9_tier1`'s sign arm, evaluated by each runtime.
rules_ds:
import math

unit dimension ledger storage int64 base cent
unit cent: ledger
unit owed: ledger = x * -100

schema L scope logical:
    id: String key
    o: owed mutable
    p: owed mutable

rule o_sign:
    L r where math.sign(r.o) == 1
->
    log info "o sign"

rule p_sign:
    L r where math.sign(r.p) == -1
->
    log info "p sign"
